title: Continuous mean curvature is locally L^p (Step 1)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold n l U) with weight mu_V, and H, h : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l) with h continuous on U and H = h mu_V-a.e. Then for every real p > 0, H is locally in L^p(mu_V) in U: the integral over K of |H|^p dmu_V is finite for every compact K contained in U (V.LocallyLp H p).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H h : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), ContinuousOn h U → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, H x = h x) → ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → V.LocallyLp H p
